notes: This Mercy is historically attested under HENRY in the 1930 Topsham death-register transcription: 'Mercy [Beveridge], wife of James', died 26 Oct 1831 aged 78 years 6 months, derived from cemetery inscription G.R.1. Wheeler's 1878 Henry genealogy says James Henry Jr. probably married Mercy Beveridge in 1776. The previously imported assertion that James Beveridge Jr. and Jean White were her parents was unsupported by original birth, probate or land records, so their parent-child link is currently excluded from the effective tree. Mercy's birthplace, exact birth date, place of death and parents remain unknown. The 1753 birth year is approximate from gravestone age. Original imported record is retained unchanged for audit.
evidence_status: Documented gravestone-derived spouse and death date; birth family and 1776 ceremony unverified.
